about_the_game:
Baron Mortimort wants to get rid of his cat... YOU!

Try to escape his mysterious manor as quickly as possible.

In each room, choose the correct door by finding the clue present.

But be quick, as you only have 1 minute per room.

Don’t give up and attempt to navigate through the manor’s 60 rooms!
